chunk.content: The sensory acceptability limit of goldband goatfish (Upeneus moluccensis) stored in ice is 8 days (11 days for red mullet), determined through sensory, microbiological and chemical freshness assessment.
chunk.source_quote: The sensory acceptability limit was 8 days for goldband goatfish (Upeneus moluccensis) and 11 days for red mullet (Mullus barbatus) stored in ice.

source.title: Sensory, microbiological and chemical assessment of the freshness of red mullet (Mullus barbatus) and goldband goatfish (Upeneus moluccensis) during storage in ice
